character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a single Chilean completo italiano as a pixel-art item for a humorous 2D side-scrolling game set in Santiago.

Show a delicious, slightly exaggerated hot dog: golden toasted bread, a reddish sausage, generous chunky green avocado, small red tomato pieces and a thick zigzag of white mayonnaise. The toppings should form distinct, readable color shapes.

Give it handmade street-food personality: slightly uneven bread, overflowing avocado and one small mayonnaise drip attached to the sandwich. Make it appetizing and playful.

Strict side view, horizontal orientation, entire item centered inside a 32x32 pixel canvas with a small transparent margin.

Crisp pixel edges, limited palette, clean dark outline, simple shading and a strong silhouette readable at actual game size. Low detail, consistent with a charming retro pixel-art platformer.

This same sprite will be picked up and launched as a projectile.

Transparent background. One complete sandwich only. No plate, wrapper, hands, face, text, scenery, floating particles or motion effects.
